name: buffered_write_byte
description: Writes one byte into a buffered output record and returns that byte. It calls the same routine again when the buffer is full or has size one, and it returns minus one with an error flag set when the record is already in error.

name: find_free_table_entry
description: Scans a fixed table of 22-byte records for one whose flag byte is clear. It zeroes the first three longwords of that record and returns its address, or a null pointer when every record is in use.

name: scan_free_record_slot
description: Scans 22-byte records starting from an address held in a register until one has a clear flag byte. It zeroes that record's first three longwords and returns it, or a null pointer when none is free.

name: clear_record_header_longs
description: Writes zero to the first three longwords of the record addressed by a register and returns. It is a short routine with no return value.

name: init_stream_buffer_pointer
description: Probes a buffer source and, when the probe succeeds with a non-null pointer, stores a 1024 size with a buffered flag and that pointer. Otherwise it stores size one and points the buffer at the record's own inline area.

name: release_all_list_nodes
description: Walks a singly linked list from a global head pointer and passes each node, with its stored size plus eight, to a release routine. It clears the list head when the walk finishes.

name: free_list_nodes_in_loop
description: Repeats over a singly linked list held in a register, releasing each node with its stored size plus eight through a routine until the link is null. It then clears the global list head.

name: allocate_linked_list_node
description: Allocates a block sized to the request plus eight bytes through a library call and pushes it onto the front of a global linked list with its owner address stored. It returns the address after the node header, or null if the allocation fails.

name: forward_low_word_argument
description: Passes the low 16 bits of its argument to a single unnamed routine and returns. It contains no other logic.

name: unlink_and_release_list_node
description: Searches a global linked list for the node whose data begins at the given address and unlinks it. It then releases that node's block sized to its stored size plus eight, returning zero when found and minus one when absent.

name: unlink_list_node_from_register
description: Scans a linked list from a starting node in a register for the record whose data starts at the address in another register. When found it unlinks and releases the record and returns zero, otherwise it returns minus one.

name: unlink_list_node_given_predecessor
description: Unlinks a record from a singly linked list using a predecessor pointer in a register, treating a null predecessor as the list head. It then calls another routine and returns zero.

name: set_list_head_to_node
description: Sets the global list head to the record addressed by a register and then calls another routine. It returns zero.

name: check_indexed_table_entry
description: Looks up a six-byte entry in a global table using the low word of its argument, passes that entry to a library call, and returns true when the call returns a nonzero value.

name: store_fallback_word_on_failure
description: Calls a check routine with its argument and, when that check returns zero, fetches a value from another routine and stores its low word in a global. In that case it returns minus one, and otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero. The routine is a stub that the code reaches through its address.

name: run_two_library_calls
description: Makes two calls through library vectors and one call to another routine, in a body of 42 instructions. The decompiler timed out, so only these calls and the three callers are known.

name: test_status_bit_and_service
description: Calls a routine with zero and 4096 and tests bit 4096 of the result. When the bit is set and a global short is nonzero, it fetches a value, passes it to a release routine and returns that routine's result, otherwise it returns zero.

name: invoke_stored_handler_then_call
description: Calls the handler whose address is stored in a global when one is installed, then calls another routine and returns.

name: open_libraries_and_split_arguments
description: Opens the dos and mathffp libraries through library calls and stores their bases in globals. When the dos library opens, it splits a text buffer at delimiter characters into a pointer table and stores the table and a few default values.

name: run_ten_steps_then_cleanup
description: Calls a routine ten times in a row, then calls an optional handler and releases two globals when they are set. It then passes two stored values to routines and returns the result of one more call, or returns its argument when a global holds a record.

name: run_ten_steps_library_call
description: Runs the same ten-call sequence and optional cleanup as its neighbour, and through its callees it calls a library function. It returns the result of the final routine or its argument.

name: append_string_bounded
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most 32766 bytes and terminating the result. It returns the destination pointer.

name: append_string_with_count_limit
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of a destination string, copying no more than the count passed in, and terminates the result. It returns the destination pointer.

name: copy_string_until_terminator
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer up to and including the zero terminator. It returns the destination pointer.

name: measure_zero_terminated_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string and returns its length, not counting the terminator.

name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies a zero-terminated source into a destination for at most the given count of bytes, then fills any remaining part of that count with zero bytes. It returns the destination pointer.

name: release_indexed_table_slot
description: Releases the block held in a numbered table slot when the index is in range and the slot is in use, clears the slot and returns zero. Otherwise it records error code three and returns minus one.

name: call_library_function_36
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 36 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_function_102
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 102 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_function_84
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 84 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_function_30
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 30 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_function_42
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 42 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_function_90
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 90 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_function_48
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 48 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_function_30_block
description: Calls the library function at offset minus 30 from a base pointer stored in a field of the structure passed as its argument. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_function_414
description: Loads a library base from a second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 414 from it. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_and_init_record
description: Obtains an index from a first routine and, when that succeeds, allocates a record through a library call. It fills the record's fields from its arguments and a fixed type byte, stores a second routine's result in it and returns the record, or zero if the allocation or the first step failed.

name: reset_record_and_release_resources
description: Releases a record's sub-block when one is present, marks the record's state as inactive and clears its counter field. It then calls two routines with the record's stored index and a fixed code, and returns nothing.

name: allocate_tagged_record
description: When its first argument is nonzero, calls a routine to allocate a record using the second argument and a fixed flag. On success it stores a state byte and the first argument in the record, and it returns the record or zero.

name: mark_record_inactive_and_release
description: When given a record, marks its state byte and two index fields as unused and passes the record and its stored size field to a release routine. It does nothing for a null record.

name: mark_record_unused_in_register
description: Marks the record addressed by a register as unused by setting its state byte and two index fields to minus one, then calls another routine.

name: call_primary_base_function_198
description: Loads a library base from the primary global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 198 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_primary_base_function_294
description: Loads a library base from the primary global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 294 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_primary_base_function_132
description: Loads a library base from the primary global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 132 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_primary_132_alias
description: Calls the same library function at offset minus 132 as its neighbouring stub, through the same library base. It returns nothing.

name: call_primary_base_function_210
description: Loads a library base from the primary global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 210 from it. It returns nothing.

name: init_empty_list_header
description: Initialises a list header in memory so that its head points past the header, its tail is cleared and its tail predecessor points back to the header. This sets up an empty list.

name: call_primary_base_function_552
description: Loads a library base from the primary global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 552 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_second_base_function_30
description: Loads a library base from the second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 30 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_second_base_function_552
description: Loads a library base from the second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 552 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_second_base_function_414
description: Loads a library base from the second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 414 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_second_base_function_198
description: Loads a library base from the second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 198 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_second_base_function_360
description: Loads a library base from the second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 360 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_second_base_function_216
description: Loads a library base from the second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 216 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_second_base_function_210
description: Loads a library base from the second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 210 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_second_base_function_306
description: Loads a library base from the second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 306 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_second_base_function_354
description: Loads a library base from the second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 354 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_second_base_function_60
description: Loads a library base from the second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 60 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_third_base_function_66
description: Loads a library base from the third global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 66 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_third_base_function_198
description: Loads a library base from a third global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 198 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_second_base_function_384
description: Loads a library base from the second global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 384 from it. It returns nothing.

name: call_other_base_function_30
description: Loads a library base from another global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 30 from it. It returns nothing.

name: load_executable_hunk_table
description: Program entry that opens the dos library and walks the hunk table of an executable, allocating memory for its sections. It reports an unsupported hunk type or a memory shortage with its own messages, and it returns an error code when loading fails.

name: read_next_longword_from_stream
description: Copies the longword at the current read pointer into a global variable and advances the pointer to the next entry.

name: allocate_block_into_table_slot
description: Allocates a memory block through a library call and stores the pointer in the next free slot of a table, then returns it. When allocation fails it records error code three, releases every block already stored, runs a shutdown sequence and returns zero.

name: close_library_and_permit
description: Calls one conditional library function when a flag is set, then calls another routine and a further library function, and returns zero. The library calls match closing a library and re-enabling multitasking.

name: free_two_stored_buffers
description: Frees each of two stored memory blocks through a library call when its pointer is nonzero. It returns nothing.

name: scan_string_between_library_calls
description: Calls a library function, measures a zero-terminated string from an address held in a register, then calls a second library function. It returns nothing.

name: decode_packed_bit_stream
description: Decodes packed data by shifting bits out of a checksum-tracked bit buffer and copying literal bytes and repeated runs into an output area. It refills the bit buffer through another routine when it runs empty.

name: shift_bit_buffer_by_count
description: Shifts a bit buffer right by a count held in a register, reloading the next longword from memory and shifting in a marker bit when the buffer runs out. It returns nothing.

name: obtain_block_and_store_value
description: Library code that calls a library function to obtain a block, and when that succeeds stores the value passed in a register at offset 34 in the block before calling another library function. It returns whether a block was obtained.

name: obtain_and_tag_block
description: Library code with the same logic as its neighbouring entry: it obtains a block through a library call, stores the value passed in a register in it and calls another library function. It returns whether a block was obtained.

name: open_dos_and_graphics_libraries
description: Opens the dos and graphics libraries by name through library calls. When both open, it initialises an empty list header in the block passed in and returns that block, otherwise it releases the block and returns zero.

name: close_library_and_free_block
description: Closes a library base and frees a memory block through two library calls, then returns zero.

name: unload_unused_list_entries
description: Walks a list of entries and removes each one whose usage count is not positive, unlinking it and unloading its segment through the dos library. It then continues with the rest of the list.

name: release_unused_entry_or_mark
description: When an entry has no users left, calls two library functions to close and free it, unlinks it from its list and returns the stored value. Otherwise it sets the entry's top flag bit and returns zero.

name: mark_entry_pending_removal
description: Sets the top flag bit in an entry's flag byte to mark it for removal and returns zero.

name: clear_pending_flag_count_up
description: Clears the top flag bit of an entry's flag byte and increments its usage counter. It returns nothing.

name: decrement_count_release_if_flagged
description: Decrements an entry's usage counter, and when the counter is still nonzero and the top flag bit is set, calls a library function and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: scan_font_file_records
description: Reads records from a font file through library calls, checks each header value against a fixed code and collects matching entries into an output list. It builds a path in a 256-byte stack buffer and returns the remaining space count.

name: copy_font_data_blocks
description: Copies successive byte blocks from a font data table into an output buffer, advancing the buffer and counters for each block. It reads a four-byte header through a library call to decide whether to continue.

name: copy_font_bytes_into_records
description: Copies source bytes one at a time into a buffer and, when the buffer reaches its limit, writes a font entry record holding its size and position. The caller's counter is updated as it goes.

name: open_font_directory_and_files
description: Opens the FONTS: directory and its .font files through dos library calls and reads their directory entries. It records the matching entries and returns the remaining space count.

name: read_font_file_blocks
description: Copies the bytes of each record into an output buffer and reads a four-byte header through a library call until the file block is used up.

name: read_font_file_entries
description: Reads entry blocks from a font file through a library read call and checks each header against a fixed code. Matching entries are copied into an output table.

name: read_font_entries_and_close
description: Reads 260-byte entry blocks from a file through a read call, writes each accepted entry's header fields into an output table, and closes the file through a library call when finished.

name: unlock_and_restore_directory
description: Releases a directory lock and restores the previous current directory through library calls. It returns the magnitude of a negative counter, or zero when the counter is not negative.

name: return_zero_without_work
description: Returns zero and performs no other work.

name: score_font_entry_match
description: Computes a match score between two font entries from their size fields, then adjusts it by a per-bit weight table for each style bit that differs. It returns minus 32767 when the reference size is zero.

name: adjust_score_for_style_pair
description: Adds or subtracts per-bit weights from a running score for each style bit that differs between two entries, working through the bits from the lowest up. It returns the adjusted score.

name: sum_style_bit_weights
description: Walks seven bit positions of a style mask, subtracting a weight from the running total at each position where the mask applies. It returns the total.

name: sum_weights_from_second_mask
description: Walks seven bit positions of a second style mask, subtracting a weight at each position where the mask applies. It returns the total once all positions are done.

name: return_minimum_match_sentinel
description: Returns the constant minus 32767 and does nothing else.

name: select_best_matching_font
description: Scores each candidate font entry against the requested entry and keeps the best-scoring one. It then locks the FONTS: directory and opens the chosen font through library calls.

name: load_matching_font_entries
description: Opens a font file, reads its header and entries through library calls, and keeps those that match the requested record in a list. It returns the final output pointer.

name: pick_best_candidate_index
description: Scans a table of 260-byte records, scores each one against the request and records the index with the highest score. It returns zero when the scan completes.

name: load_best_candidate_segments
description: Repeatedly chooses the best-scoring record and, for each accepted record, loads its segment through a library call inside a forbid and permit pair. It links each loaded entry into a list and returns the final list pointer.

name: unload_font_records_and_segments
description: Clears the flag word of each record in a table and unloads any loaded segments through library calls. It then releases the list links and returns the final list pointer.

name: close_font_directory_and_release
description: Clears the flag word of records in a table, then closes a file and unlocks a directory through library calls. It releases the table once no records remain.

name: copy_string_with_terminator_check
description: Copies a zero-terminated byte string from a source to a destination, including the terminator. It returns nothing.

name: append_string_to_end
description: Moves to the terminating zero of a destination string and calls a copy routine with the source argument, so the source is appended. It returns nothing.

name: forward_call_no_arguments
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns, passing control on without other work.

name: count_bytes_until_nul
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string and returns the count, not including the terminator.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: Returns at once without doing anything.

name: compare_strings_ordered
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns zero when they are equal, one when the first differing byte is larger in the first string and minus one when it is smaller.

name: compare_last_byte_order
description: Compares the byte before a reference pointer with the byte at a second pointer and returns minus one when the first is smaller, otherwise one.

name: find_char_in_string
description: Searches a zero-terminated string for the given byte and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or a null pointer when it is absent.

name: find_char_from_register
description: Searches forward from the pointer in a register for the byte held in another register. It returns the address of the match, or a null pointer when the string ends first.

name: return_zero_no_op
description: Returns zero and performs no other work.

name: find_last_char_in_string
description: Searches a zero-terminated string backwards for the given byte and returns a pointer to its last occurrence, or a null pointer when it is absent.

name: find_last_char_from_register
description: Searches backwards from the pointer in a register for the byte held in another register. It returns the address of the match, or a null pointer when none is found.

name: return_zero_no_op_second
description: Returns zero and performs no other work.

name: check_name_has_no_separators
description: Looks for a slash and then a colon in a zero-terminated name. It returns the name pointer when neither character is present, otherwise it returns the pointer where the search found the first character.

name: return_nothing_no_op
description: Returns immediately and performs no work.

name: dispatch_single_call_wrapper
description: Invokes another routine and returns, with no arguments and no other work.

name: forward_to_second_routine_call
description: Calls another routine and returns, with nothing else done.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: When the destination pointer is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed table into it, then calls a code pointer held in a register. It returns nothing.

name: free_memory_and_run_cleanup
description: Program entry that calls a routine, invokes a code pointer from a register and calls two more routines. It then frees memory through a library call and clears a longword in the block.

name: run_cleanup_then_free_memory
description: Runs the same cleanup sequence as its duplicate in another installer: it calls routines, invokes a code pointer, frees memory through a library call and clears a longword.

name: decode_bit_stream_with_lookup
description: Decodes symbols from a bit stream by shifting bits in and looking up masked values in a table, writing the results to an output buffer. It calls a bit shift routine and a table lookup routine for each step.

name: run_startup_until_zero
description: Program entry that runs several routines and repeatedly calls one of them until it returns zero. It then runs three more routines and returns the value held in a register.

name: open_intuition_and_disable_interrupts
description: Opens the intuition library and the topaz font through library calls, then writes the interrupt control register to disable interrupts. It polls the controller port and button registers in loops while it waits.

name: wait_until_result_nonzero
description: Repeatedly calls a routine until the result register it reads from holds a nonzero value. It returns nothing.

name: poll_routine_until_nonzero
description: Calls a routine in a loop and stops when the result register holds a nonzero value. It returns nothing.

name: advance_index_with_wrap_check
description: Increments a byte counter stored in a global and compares it with a fixed limit of sixteen. It returns minus one when the limit is reached, otherwise it walks short-word entries and calls four further routines.

name: return_empty_stub
description: Returns at once without any work.

name: return_empty_stub_two
description: Returns at once without any work.

name: return_empty_stub_three
description: Returns at once without any work.

name: set_chip_bits_and_permit
description: Calls two routines, then writes three saved words, each with the top bit set, into fixed offsets from a base register. It copies a longword into a second structure and calls exec.Permit to re-enable multitasking.

name: clear_chip_control_words
description: Writes the value 32767 into three words at fixed offsets from a base register. With the top bit clear, the write clears the matching bits in those control words.

name: return_empty_stub_four
description: Returns at once with no action.

name: open_graphics_save_chip_state
description: Forbids multitasking and opens the graphics library through a library call. It saves three words of the current state, writes several control words in the custom register block and calls two further routines.

name: wait_for_status_byte_sequence
description: Polls a status byte at a fixed offset from a base register, first until it reads minus one and then until it reads the letter X. It returns nothing.

name: build_four_pointer_table_entries
description: Fills four pairs of words in a table with the high and low halves of an address that steps by 10240 bytes each time. It then stores the table address at a fixed offset from the base register.

name: start_command_as_background_task
description: Program entry that parses its argument string, opens the dos library and starts the requested command in the background with input and output sent to the null device. It reports an invalid parameter when the argument is missing.

name: report_missing_name_message
description: Measures a zero-terminated name and passes it to two library functions, with the message text 'Can't find' in its data. It reports a name that could not be found.

name: run_cleanup_then_free_block
description: Performs the same cleanup sequence as its duplicates in other installers: it calls routines, invokes a code pointer, frees memory through a library call and clears a longword.

name: busy_wait_short_countdown
description: Decrements a short counter held in a register until it reaches minus one, then returns. It is a busy-wait delay.

name: find_maximum_list_field_value
description: Program entry that walks a linked list and tracks the largest value found in a field of each entry, starting from a fixed minimum of 149. It then calls two routines and continues with further processing when a result is nonzero.

name: lookup_library_values_into_globals
description: Calls a library function with a fixed string, clears a byte in a buffer and stores the returned value in a global. It repeats this for a second value and records each result in its own global.

name: free_memory_then_close_library
description: Calls three routines, including wrappers for freeing memory and closing a library, and returns zero.

name: store_four_results_in_globals
description: Calls a routine four times in succession and stores each returned value in one of four global variables at fixed offsets. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_memory_plus_offset
description: Allocates memory through a library call and, when the allocation succeeds, returns its address plus 32768. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: retry_open_library_until_success
description: Calls a library open function repeatedly, with an empty loop body, until it returns a nonzero library base.

name: pass_through_single_call
description: Calls another routine and returns, with nothing else done.

name: copy_bytes_eight_byte_blocks
description: Copies a byte sequence from a source pointer to a destination pointer, moving eight bytes per pass when the length is at least eight. It advances both pointers as it goes.

name: reset_two_globals_return_pointer
description: Clears two global variables, calls another routine and returns a code pointer to a routine in the same file.

name: poll_until_condition_flag
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until the condition flag from its last operation is set. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_node_and_push
description: Allocates a node through a library call and links it at the front of the list held in a global, storing the owner address in it. It returns the address after the node header, and when the allocation fails it calls another routine and returns no node.

name: unlink_list_node_and_free
description: Searches the list held in a global for the node at the given address, unlinks it when found and releases it through a library call.

name: find_list_tail_pointer
description: Walks a linked list from the pointer in a register until the next link is null, then stores the final node in a global.

name: preserve_global_across_two_calls
description: Saves a global list pointer, calls two routines and restores the saved pointer afterward. It returns nothing.

name: restore_global_after_two_calls
description: Saves a global list pointer, calls two routines and restores the saved pointer afterward. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_block_and_track
description: Allocates a block through a library call and links it at the front of the list held in a global. It returns the address after the block header, and when the allocation fails it calls another routine and returns no block.

name: release_node_from_global_list
description: Searches the list held in a global for the node that matches its argument, unlinks it when found and releases it through a library call. It returns nothing.

name: launch_background_run_command
description: Walks a linked list of entries and, once it reaches the end, makes a library call with command text that contains RunBack and TEAM17 and redirects output to the null device.

name: allocate_and_push_global_node
description: Allocates a block through a library call and pushes it onto the front of a global list, clearing its second longword. It returns the data pointer of the new block.

name: free_global_list_nodes
description: Removes the first node from a global list and releases it through a library call, then releases each node in the chain it points to the same way.

name: find_largest_field_then_setup
description: Walks a linked list to find the largest value stored in a field of its entries, starting from a fixed minimum of 149. It then calls two further routines to finish its setup using that value.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_invoke
description: When the destination pointer is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a table in the object into it, then calls a code pointer held in a register. It returns nothing.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only an unimplemented instruction decodes at this address, so the code is a stub of bad data with no behaviour to describe.

name: store_argument_in_global
description: Stores the register argument in a global variable and returns.

name: release_entry_when_unused
description: When the entry's counter field is zero, unlinks it from its list, releases it through a library call and returns the stored global value. Otherwise it sets the flag bit with value eight in the entry and returns zero.

name: mark_entry_pending_release
description: Sets the flag bit with value eight in the entry's flag byte and returns zero.

name: acquire_library_entry_usage
description: Adds a user to a library entry's counter unless its flag bit with value eight is set. On the first user it stores a global and calls a library function with it, then returns the entry, and it returns minus one when the entry is flagged.

name: release_library_entry_usage
description: Removes one user from a library entry's counter. When the count reaches zero and the flag bit with value eight is set it releases the entry through a library call and returns that result.

name: dispatch_single_call_stub
description: Calls another routine and returns, with nothing else done.

name: run_float_mantissa_steps
description: Handles a packed floating-point value with a 23-bit mantissa: it returns at once for zero, passes negative values to another routine, and otherwise runs a 23-step loop that shifts the mantissa against a fixed bias.

name: shift_subtract_bit_loop
description: Repeatedly shifts and subtracts bit by bit using two input registers and a counter, stopping when the counter reaches minus one. It returns the value in the first register.

name: adjust_status_flag_bits
description: Calls a library routine, then returns its result with the flag bit of value eight cleared and the flag bit of value two set.

name: run_nine_library_call_sequence
description: Calls a fixed sequence of nine library functions through offsets from a base register, mostly alternating between two of them. It returns nothing.

name: dispatch_float_operation_by_sign
description: Runs library calls chosen by two sign flags and the sign of a value, then returns a result from another routine with bits adjusted. It is math library code.

name: dispatch_float_operation_variant
description: Variant of its neighbouring entry that runs library calls chosen by sign and zero flags, then returns a masked result from another routine.

name: select_float_op_by_flags
description: Selects library calls by a zero test on one value and a sign test on another, then returns a result from another routine with a bit mask applied.

name: dispatch_float_op_zero_test
description: Calls library functions chosen by a zero test and a sign test on the operands, then returns a result from another routine with two flag bits cleared.

name: finish_float_op_clear_bits
description: Calls library functions chosen by a sign test and a secondary value, then returns a result from another routine with two flag bits cleared.

name: finish_float_op_single
description: Calls one library function, then returns the result of another routine with two flag bits cleared.

name: finish_float_op_double_call
description: Calls a library function twice, then returns the result of another routine with two flag bits cleared.

name: finish_float_op_paired_calls
description: Calls a library function twice through a second library base, then returns the result of another routine with two flag bits cleared.

name: normalise_float_bits
description: Clears the sign bit of a value, checks an exponent range and shifts the bits by a count derived from the exponent before calling routines to store the result. It is math library code.

name: run_shift_compare_loop
description: Runs a 24-step loop that shifts a value and compares it with another, subtracting the shifted amount at each step where it fits. It calls routines when the steps are used up.

name: run_shift_add_loop
description: Runs a loop that shifts and adds a value, then subtracts a shifted remainder while counting a bit position down to minus one. It calls routines when the loop finishes.

name: check_operand_byte_range
description: Tests the low byte of the operand against a fixed threshold and returns early when it lies outside the range handled here. Otherwise it calls one routine.

name: check_signed_byte_thresholds
description: Tests a signed byte of the operand against fixed thresholds and returns early for values in the ignored range. Otherwise it calls one routine.

name: check_double_byte_threshold
description: Doubles the low byte of the operand and compares it with two thresholds, returning early above the upper limit. Otherwise it calls one routine.

name: scale_operand_when_in_range
description: Checks the low byte against a threshold and, when it is in the handled range, calls three routines. It then computes a masked value from the operand with a loop over its bits.

name: handle_sign_bit_operand
description: Splits the operand by its sign bit and calls routines for the negative and positive cases. It returns early when the value is outside the handled range.

name: reduce_angle_by_fixed_constant
description: Reduces an operand by repeatedly adding or subtracting a fixed multiple of a constant until it falls within one period. It then calls routines to finish the computation.

name: compute_adjusted_operand_value
description: Computes an adjusted operand from a fixed table of constants and the operand's low byte, looping until the value is in range. It then calls routines to finish.

name: iterate_constant_series_terms
description: Iterates a series of shifted terms built from two fixed constants and the operand, updating an accumulator until a step count runs out. It calls one routine when finished.

name: accumulate_series_terms_loop
description: Repeatedly adds and subtracts terms held in several registers while decrementing a count. When the count reaches minus one it calls routines to check and finish the result.

name: return_empty_stub_five
description: Returns at once with no work.

name: forward_single_call_pass
description: Calls another routine and returns, with nothing else done.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

name: pack_integer_to_float_form
description: Packs a 32-bit integer in a register into a floating-point form with a biased exponent, normalising it by shifting. Values in the small range skip the normalising step.

name: pack_integer_to_float_entry
description: Packs the integer in a register into the same floating-point form as its neighbouring entry, normalising it by shifting. It returns at once when a high byte check shows the value is already in range.

name: call_one_then_two_routines
description: Calls one routine, then calls two more because a local flag stays false. It returns nothing.

name: call_one_then_three_routines
description: Calls one routine, then calls three more because a local flag stays false. It returns nothing.

name: step_byte_and_call_routines
description: When the byte argument is nonzero and does not overflow when incremented, calls a routine, then calls two routines with the incremented byte and one more routine. It returns nothing.
